description: Stacks seven layers of colour over a background, each with its own colour, transparency and blend mode, and sends the result out as red, green, blue and alpha voltages

params.text: Scales the background's red or hue input before its offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets the background's red, or its hue in HSV, on its own while nothing is patched to that jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1
Scales the background's green or saturation input before its offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets the background's green, or its saturation in HSV, on its own while nothing is patched to that jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1
Scales the background's blue or value input before its offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets the background's blue, or its value in HSV, on its own while nothing is patched to that jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1
Chooses what the background is: Off leaves it transparent black, RGB reads the three background jacks as red, green and blue, HSV reads them as hue, saturation and value
Sets how many of each layer's lamps are lit: 1 marks the blend mode alone, 2 adds a lamp showing that layer's own colour, All adds its alpha and the colour built up beneath it
Sets where colours are held to the 0 to 1 range: Off never, End once after the last layer, All after every layer
Scales that layer's red or hue input before its offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets that layer's red, or its hue in HSV, on its own while nothing is patched to that jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1
Scales that layer's green or saturation input before its offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets that layer's green, or its saturation in HSV, on its own while nothing is patched to that jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1
Scales that layer's blue or value input before its offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets that layer's blue, or its value in HSV, on its own while nothing is patched to that jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 to 1
Scales that layer's alpha input before its alpha offset is added, -1 to 1
Sets that layer's opacity on its own while nothing is patched to its alpha jack, and is added to that jack when something is; 0 is invisible and 1 is solid
Reads that layer's first three jacks as hue, saturation and value rather than as red, green and blue
Chooses how that layer is combined with the colour beneath it — Normal, Addition, Multiply, Screen or Overlay — and the five-colour lamp marks the choice

inputs.text: Sets the background's red, or its hue in HSV, through the two trimpots of that column; 0V for none and 10V for full
Sets the background's green, or its saturation in HSV, through the two trimpots of that column; 0V for none and 10V for full
Sets the background's blue, or its value in HSV, through the two trimpots of that column; 0V for none and 10V for full
Sets that layer's red, or its hue in HSV, through the two trimpots of that column; 0V for none and 10V for full
Sets that layer's green, or its saturation in HSV, through the two trimpots of that column; 0V for none and 10V for full
Sets that layer's blue, or its value in HSV, through the two trimpots of that column; 0V for none and 10V for full
Sets that layer's opacity through the two alpha trimpots; 0V is invisible and 10V is solid

outputs.text: The red of the finished picture, 0V for none and 10V for full
The green of the finished picture, 0V for none and 10V for full
The blue of the finished picture, 0V for none and 10V for full
The opacity of the finished picture, 0V where nothing has been drawn and 10V where it is solid

notes: the rows are numbered 7 at the top down to 1 at the bottom, and they are composited from 1 upwards, so row 7 is drawn last and covers the rest
every output carries as many channels as the widest cable patched anywhere on the module, so a polyphonic picture is composited a channel at a time
a layer with its alpha left at 0 changes nothing, so the module passes the background through until an alpha offset is raised or an alpha jack is patched
the alpha output only rises where a layer set to Normal has drawn something; the other four blend modes leave the opacity alone
